description: This file defines the AppEnv class, which provides static methods to load environment variables from a .env file using the flutter_dotenv package. It exposes a load() method to initialize environment variables and a get() method to access individual variables.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class for loading and accessing environment variables in a Flutter application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the .env file. Checks if already initialized to prevent reloading.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key from environment variables, returning null if the key is missing.
